[[Image:Mistvale Valley.jpg|thumb|300px|Mistvale Valley]]
'''Mistvale Valley''' is a valley in the southern part of Stranglethorn Vale inhabited by the great Mistvale [[gorilla]]s. Adventurers often come through, looking to find [[Mistvale Giblets]], [[Gorilla Fang]]s, or the very rare [[Aged Gorilla Sinew]].
